story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я думала, что скорость — это главное

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Оставаться на дороге тоже помогает

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ладно. Еще один тренировочный круг

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ПОСЛЕ ПЕРВОЙ ГОНКИ

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: И у меня есть очень серьезный вопрос

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты финишировал так далеко впереди меня 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я играла в это гораздо больше. Не сравнивай свою первую гонку с этим

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я тоже застряла, смотря в другую сторону

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Но ты прошел последний поворот чисто

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Это тот самый поворот, в который ты все время врезалась на тренировке

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я это заметила

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Видишь? Ты уже уловил тайминг

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Хорошо. Снова

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Та же трасса?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Да. У меня с ней незавершенные дела

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я слушаю

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ПОСЛЕ ВТОРОГО ЗАЕЗДА — {{name:lena}} все еще финиширует позади тебя, но проходит трассу с меньшим количеством аварий.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Все равно проиграла

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Проверь свое время, кстати

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты финишировал намного быстрее, чем в первом заезде

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: А я только дважды закружилась

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Точно. Ты вспомнил замедлиться перед резкими поворотами

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я повторяла твои инструкции в голове

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Они сработали. Это был гораздо лучший круг

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты милый, потому что я твоя девушка

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я бы сказал тебе, если бы ты не стала лучше

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты бы поиграла со мной сегодня вечером?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Быстрый круг — это потому, что ты лучше водила

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Хорошо, это хороший ответ ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Хочешь остановиться или попробовать другую трассу?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Еще один на этой

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я хочу посмотреть, смогу ли я сделать это без аварий

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: ПОСЛЕ ОДНОГО ПОСЛЕДНЕГО ЗАЕЗДА

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я почти справилась

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты только задел барьер в конце

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Потому что я разволновалась и забыла тормозить

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Твоя первая половина была действительно хороша. Продолжай в том же духе, и остальное получится

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Подожди. Ты спрашиваешь МЕНЯ поиграть?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я хочу реванш в другой вечер

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я была бы очень счастлива с этим

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты все еще улыбаешься, когда я спрашиваю, да?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Немного

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Мне нравится делиться этим с тобой

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Мне тоже. Даже если ты раздражающе труден для поимки

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Теперь ты понимаешь, почему я всегда хочу еще один раунд

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: К сожалению, да 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты играл в такие игры, когда был маленьким?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Да. Я наклонялся вбок с контроллером, как будто это помогало мне поворачивать

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Да 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я делала это сегодня 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Значит, у тебя отличные инстинкты

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Похоже, все, кроме машины, поняли, что я хотела

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: В следующий раз мы поработаем над тем, чтобы машина тоже участвовала

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Спасибо, что были терпеливы со мной сегодня

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Мне было весело. Тебе не обязательно выигрывать, чтобы мне нравилось играть с тобой

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Мне тоже было весело ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ладно. Готовлюсь к завтрашнему дню, потом спать

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Спокойной ночи, дорогая. Спасибо, что пригласила меня поиграть

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Спокойной ночи ❤️ Мы повторим это

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Почему ты так удивлена?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты никогда не предлагаешь это. Обычно я рассказываю тебе о своих играх

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Мне правда приятно, что ты спросила

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Сегодня у меня целый день свободен.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Хочешь пойти со мной за покупками?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Мне нужны новые брюки. Врач снял гипс два дня назад, так что я наконец могу снова носить брюки, которые нормально сидят.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Я ждала повода выйти из дома без чувства вины за учёбу.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Дай мне тридцать минут, чтобы выглядеть не как катастрофа

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
Yeah. How are you feeling today?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Да. Как ты себя сегодня чувствуешь?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Все еще немного устала, но мой мозг уже не совсем в каше

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Хорошо. Когда ты снова увидишь своего профессора?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Иногда каждый день, если он думает, что мне это нужно.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Он серьезно относится к этим "дополнительным занятиям".

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Привет ❤️ Я решила, что мы никогда не смотрели этот фильм, и моя репутация все еще в порядке

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хорошо, значит, это не только я

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: А у тебя? Ночь была лучше?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Гораздо лучше, я встал и приготовил завтрак, прежде чем проверить телефон

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не оставив за собой след из вещей, которые ты уронил?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Одна ложка, но я её поднял

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я горжусь твоим очень амбициозным утром ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я тоже надел обе туфли

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Сидишь?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Сижу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Видишь, тебя можно научить 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Доброе утро и тебе, детектив

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Как у тебя завтрак?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Всё нормально, проблема в том, что я собираю сумку

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я беру пасту с прошлой ночи, чтобы меня не ограбил ещё один сэндвич

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Будущее Ты наконец-то что-то получил от того ужина

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Она получила еду и очень полную сумку

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Положи еду сверху

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Тогда мне придётся нести книгу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Неси книгу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты делаешь всё таким простым, когда не ты пытаешься закрыть эту молнию 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты мог бы что-то оставить дома

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не начинай, я даже завтрак еще не успела поесть 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Мне всё это нужно

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Включая то, что лежит на дне уже три недели?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты не знаешь, что на дне

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Правда?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Дело не в этом

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Подожди, кажется, я понял

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Пожалуйста, оцени, что я одета и готова до последней минуты

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты выглядишь очень хорошо ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Спасибо, красавчик 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Красный шарф поможет тебе почувствовать себя лучше?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Сумка выглядит так, будто вот-вот проиграет бой

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Комплимент девушке, а не багажу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Девушка прекрасна. Багажу я сочувствую

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Гораздо лучше 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Снова занятия этим утром?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Да, потом сразу на работу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я бы хотел всё закончить, не глядя на часы в последний час

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Разумная цель

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Что ты собираешься делать сегодня?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Собираюсь разобрать тот кухонный шкаф, который я избегал

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: В следующий раз, когда я приду, я спрячу твой пульт

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Та, из которой всё падает на тебя, когда открываешь?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я предпочитаю думать об этом как о сюрпризе

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты могла бы просто положить туда меньше вещей 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я освобождаю место для хороших кружек с кофе

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Важно, я не хочу, чтобы наш первый нормальный кофе был из мерного стакана

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты испортила всю мою презентацию

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Сохрани усилия для кофе, я не буду слишком судить о кружке ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я бы лучше сводил тебя на кофе скоро

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Мне бы это понравилось

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ладно, мне нужно уходить, прежде чем прийти слишком рано и пропустить автобус

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это звучит как признание

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Наверное, я не буду много на телефоне сегодня днем

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не забудь свой обед после всех этих усилий

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Он уже врезается мне в бок, я не смогла бы забыть его, даже если бы пыталась 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я напишу тебе, когда доберусь до бара сегодня вечером, как и говорила

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хорошо, хорошего дня

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: И тебе, красавчик ❤️ Люблю тебя

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я тебя тоже люблю

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это звучит как предупреждение 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты хоть хорошо поспала?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Да, как только я перестала пытаться понять, как вообще имеет смысл финал

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не получилось

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
Thanks for the vote of confidence
I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Я увидела что-то очень классное у входа

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Мы можем сначала заплатить, а потом поесть.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Привет ❤️ Мы в баре, и я наконец села где-то, что не офисный стул

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты можешь продолжать насмехаться над моими рекомендациями, но, похоже, тебе это нравится

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
See, that wasn't difficult
You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты будешь невыносимым по этому поводу всю ночь, не так ли?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Только до тех пор, пока ты не перестанешь удивляться, что у меня хороший вкус

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
You don't have to
And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: А ты? Что ты на самом деле делаешь, когда не в этом офисе?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Выходи, найди хорошее место, где поесть, и поезжай куда-нибудь, когда у меня будет свободный день

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И скажи всем, где сесть, когда ты доберешься?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Кто-то должен остановить их от выбора стола рядом с туалетом

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
Why would I?
I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не могу понять, это уверенность или полное отсутствие стыда

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Пока музыканты настраиваются на другом конце комнаты...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
Looks like it
I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я думала, это просто оборудование с другой ночи

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: У нас есть маленький столик у боковой стены

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я решаю, стоит ли попросить меню

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
You've noticed
I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я весь день ношу с собой остатки пасты. Дай посмотрю что-то другое

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
I'm checking the time
Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Твой парень ждет от тебя вестей?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я сказала, что дам ему знать, что я делаю

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
Why?
So he knows why you're staying
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Чтобы он знал, почему ты остаешься

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я еще не сказала, что остаюсь

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты смотришь на это меню уже пять минут

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Тогда оставайся и поешь со мной

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ладно, я тоже хочу послушать немного музыки

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
I thought you'd say that
Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Дай мне минутку, я скажу ему

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мы собираемся что-то поесть перед уходом, здесь начинается группа 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да, я не знала, что у них сегодня живая музыка

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Лаваш и картошка фри, ничего особенного

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Лучше, чем носить с собой свой обед весь вечер

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Этот контейнер теперь пуст, он может перестать судить мои решения 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я думала, ты просто идешь выпить

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я тоже, но нам хорошо, и я не ела с обеда

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И стул не пытается сломать мне спину, за что я благодарна

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я все равно напишу тебе, когда вернусь домой ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
When the food arrives...
Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ужин, прежде чем я съем все картошку фри 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Пахнет тоже хорошо, я собираюсь поесть, пока горячо

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
Talk in a bit ❤️
Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
Have you ordered?
I took one photo, you'll survive
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я сделала одно фото, ты выживешь

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: На фото мы выглядели лучше без телефона между нами

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты можешь получить мое внимание, не драматизируя

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Тогда положи его и попробуй так

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
No, the tablecloth
Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Продолжай говорить, а я съем твою половину

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я заказала дополнительную картошку фри не просто так

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
Careful, that's nearly another compliment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Осторожно, это почти еще один комплимент

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not yet, I'm still looking
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Еще нет, я все еще смотрю

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few songs into the set...
What did you say?
Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Подвинь свой стул сюда, я не собираюсь кричать через стол

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты мог просто попросить меня сесть рядом с тобой

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
In the most bossy way possible
And yet you're moving the chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И все же ты двигаешь стул

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Потому что я тебя не слышу, не выгляди так довольным

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Дай мне убрать свою сумку, прежде чем ты наступишь на нее

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
Is the book getting its own chair too?
It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: У нее лучшие манеры, чем у тебя, она заслуживает стул

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} подвигает свой стул к менеджеру, чтобы услышать его через музыку

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Она наклоняется ближе, чтобы ответить ему, ее рука на мгновение rests на его предплечье

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Меня задевает именно её рука на его предплечье. Такой маленький жест, а я сижу и думаю, насколько ближе они ещё станут.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
A Little Closer
You know this one?
Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да, не проси меня петь это

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to risk the evening
Excuse you, I might be very good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Извини, я могу быть очень хороша

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Может быть. Мне слишком нравится это, чтобы выяснять

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
Did the cupboard survive you?
You laughed
That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это не делает тебя менее ужасным

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Менее уставшая, чем я была в шесть?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты действительно смотришь мне в глаза, когда говоришь со мной

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
I like looking at you
You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты мог бы попытаться быть более тонким

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
I noticed
It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Сейчас он в нескольких кучах по всей кухне

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
After the set, with the plates cleared...
I should check the bus times
I'll get the bill
I can pay for my food
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я могу заплатить за свою еду

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I invited you
That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это не значит, что я не могу заплатить

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это значит, что я плачу сегодня

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really are like this everywhere
You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: У тебя не было скучного вечера, да?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так что ты на том этапе, когда жалеешь, что начала 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
There's a bus in about twenty minutes
Plenty of time. Get your jacket
Please?
Get your jacket, please
See, you can learn
Deeply
Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Оставь мне хотя бы одну пригодную кружку, ладно?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я на время откладываю телефон, напишу тебе, когда буду дома ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
At their table, a little later...
A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: У барной стойки замечен разговор рядом с {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Она говорила, что они просто выпьют после работы. Хочется верить, что я могу отнестись к этому спокойно, но я всё смотрю на экран.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
You look good
You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты видел меня на работе час назад

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Там есть еда, так что это уже большой выигрыш 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это почему ты всё время смотрел в мою сторону?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты думал, что я проверяю, закончил ли ты отчёт?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
The report got finished, didn't it?
No work talk tonight
You brought it up
I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я уже вижу, что ты будешь утомительным

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так ты разговариваешь со своим боссом?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Напомнить, что мой босс сделал со мной?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
..what good weather we have today
Yeah I thought so
You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты улыбаешься с тех пор, как сел. Я рискну

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
On a good evening
We've barely started
Exactly
Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ладно, прежде чем твоя голова станет ещё больше, что ты будешь заказывать?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Почти, мне пришлось очень аккуратно положить контейнер с обедом обратно в сумку

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Только когда я знаю, о чём говорю

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так что, по твоему мнению, везде

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're getting to know me
Unfortunately
I'm having the orange one
Just to disagree with me?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Просто чтобы не согласиться со мной?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Потому что мне это нравится. Шокирующе, знаю

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ладно, но не проси мой, когда передумаешь

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не переживай, я не дам тебе этого удовольствия

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: После того, как их напитки придут...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
Okay, the table was a good choice
So was the bar
You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты можешь принять один комплимент, не собирая остальные

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
Do you come here a lot?
Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Достаточно часто, чтобы знать, какой стол не рядом с колонкой

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я привела друга сюда на его день рождения в прошлом месяце. Он пригласил шесть человек и не забронировал ничего

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он назвал это спонтанностью. Я позвонила владельцу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да, она провела целый рабочий день, не будучи открытой ни разу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так что твоя история о спасении вечера на самом деле история о том, что ты кого-то знаешь

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Надеюсь, он купил тебе ужин после этого

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Конечно. Если я это организую и заплачу, мы можем отпраздновать мой день рождения вместо этого

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
What?
The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Часть, где ты делаешь себя главным событием

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не думаю, что смогу соперничать с твоим героическим резервированием стола

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
A useful contribution
All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ладно, вчера мой профессор объяснял неправильный слайд десять минут

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мы все записывали. У меня было полстраницы, прежде чем кто-то наконец спросил

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я была занята тем, что думала, что он знает больше, чем я

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты так ошибаешься со всеми, кто у власти?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Все реже и реже в последнее время

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good
That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это не было комплиментом для тебя

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я не восприняла это как комплимент

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Emotional support literature 😌
That makes a change
{{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} смеется со своим менеджером за их напитками

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Эта улыбка ранит сильнее, чем я ожидал. Раньше, видя её, я чувствовал, что именно со мной она хочет быть.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
Away From the Office
What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Что ты делаешь, когда занятия заканчиваются?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Сплю, пока не перестану ненавидеть свой будильник

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я хочу день на пляже с книгой и без расписания

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не какое-то большое организованное событие, просто достаточно времени, чтобы мне не нужно было постоянно проверять телефон

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я знаю хорошее место вдали от главного пляжа

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
What's the place like?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Надеюсь, твой профессор завалит тебя кучей наказательных упражнений завтра.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
Extra work with him is… fine
Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: В любом случае, я собираюсь спать, прежде чем ты снова начнешь меня допрашивать.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Мы пошли за моими штанами, а ты всё равно купила больше, чем я.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
And yet you still invited me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: А ты всё равно меня пригласила.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
You sound like me
Someone has to
Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ладно, я достану это через минуту 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Как прошёл твой день? Ты закончила с шкафом?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Закончила его, а потом как-то начала с ящика снизу

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я нашёл столько столовых приборов на вынос, что можно открыть ресторан

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Пожалуйста, скажи, что ты что-то выбросила

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
Most?
Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Не заставляй меня жалеть о сказанном

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Может произойти внезапная экстренная ситуация с вилками

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я это учту, если моя пропадёт 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: На самом деле, приятно, что всё разложено по местам

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Теперь ты можешь найти кружки, не рискуя, что что-то упадёт на тебя

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
I was going to ask about that
My collection of forks?
Coming over, idiot ❤️
I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я проверила завтрашние часы перед тем, как уйти сегодня. Заканчиваю в пять

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Могу прийти после работы? Около шести?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
Yeah, of course
You don't have somewhere else to be?
No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Нет, я хочу провести вечер с тобой

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Мы можем что-то приготовить, а ты выберешь фильм, который не оскорбит нас обоих

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты уверена, что сможешь обойтись без расследования преступления?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я вместо этого проведу расследование на кухне

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
I'll bring protective equipment 😭
I missed having you here
Obviously
I missed it too
And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: И я хочу настоящие объятия, а не ещё одно сообщение об этом

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Хорошо ❤️ Я напишу тебе, когда уйду с работы завтра

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты лучше будь, я не собираюсь ждать целый день, чтобы узнать, что ты вышла 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
Don't take the good cushion
Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Все ещё ставишь условия в своём доме

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
Your stop is down here
Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ладно, я иду спать, прежде чем засну с включённым светом

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Да, он в раковине. Ты можешь прекратить меня контролировать 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
Good night handsome, love you ❤️
Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я тоже тебя люблю, увидимся завтра

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
I know where it is
The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Музыка была хорошей. Я бы осталась дольше, если бы не дела завтра

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Мы будем знать на следующий раз

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты уже решаешь, что будет следующий раз?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я говорю, что снова бы тебя вывела.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты мог бы оставить немного места для неопределенности.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Разговор продолжается, пока двое идут к автобусной остановке

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Они выходят вместе. Я должен радоваться, что вечер заканчивается, но не могу избавиться от ощущения, что жду чего-то ещё хуже.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
Why? I know what I want
That must be nice
You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты тоже не спешил к двери.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Они останавливаются на более тихом углу, с автобусной остановкой, видимой дальше по улице...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я весь вечер хотела тебя снова поцеловать.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты действительно ничего не держишь при себе.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
Don't get ahead of yourself
Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Тогда перестань смотреть на мои губы.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я не осознавала, как громко было там, пока мы не вышли

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: У меня есть парень. Это не изменилось с вчерашнего дня.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я знаю. Я не притворяюсь, что пригласила тебя только поговорить о работе.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Нет, ты это очень ясно дала понять.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: На этот раз, можешь перестать выглядеть таким самодовольным?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
{{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Менеджер наклоняется и целует её; она отвечает на поцелуй.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: На этот раз она сама притягивает его ближе. Уже не получится убеждать себя, что всё это было только его поступком.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
Before the Bus
Don't say it
Say what?
You were managing to make yourself heard
Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Что бы ты ни собирался сказать с таким самодовольством.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я собирался сказать, что у меня был хороший вечер.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Почему-то ты всё равно заставил это звучать самодовольно.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
Don't push your luck
Worth a try
I need to go now
Your bus isn't here yet
I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я знаю, но я собираюсь подождать на остановке.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Только потому, что ты заставлял меня наклоняться, чтобы ответить

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
That's where I'll be
Good night
Good night, {{name:lena}}
A little later, on the bus home...
I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я в автобусе ❤️ Скоро буду дома.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Да, и моя сумка наконец-то снята с плеча

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: У неё был гораздо более захватывающий день, чем она заслуживала 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
Was it a long walk to the stop?
No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Нет, он проводил меня до угла, а потом я пошла ждать автобус

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
I'll text you when I'm inside
All right
Once she is home...
Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Привет ❤️ Я дома, ты смог не уснуть?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Извини, мы задержались дольше, чем я ожидала

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты очень быстро решаешь, что мне нравится, а что нет

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Еда была хорошей, а группа сыграла полный сет

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: В основном каверы, пару я знала, а несколько делала вид, что знаю 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Запомню это в следующий раз, когда ты будешь смотреть, как я что-то играю

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Это совершенно другое, я всегда понимаю твои сложные игровые решения 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Бар был классным. Я раньше там не была

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Так скажи мне. У тебя был хороший вечер?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Да, и он большую часть вечера заботился о том, чтобы я оценила его отличный вкус

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Похоже, он такой же и вне работы

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Он определённо любит, когда всё по его

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Я заставила его добавить 'пожалуйста', когда он сказал мне взять куртку

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
I'm choosing to count it 😌
You sound like you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ты звучишь так, будто хорошо провела время

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
Yes, I did
I'm glad you're home
Me too ❤️
Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Дай мне минутку переодеться, не хочу больше сидеть в этой одежде

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
A few minutes later...
There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Вот, без обуви и ничего не осталось нести

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
Much. The bag can wait until morning
At least take the lunch box out
There we go

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Так, как себя чувствует будущая выпускница сегодня?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Не могу дождаться, когда диплом будет у меня в руках

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Легко забыть, когда он всегда в спортивной одежде

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Я в основном хочу летнее тело

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Тот комментарий вчера действительно задел тебя, да?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Я хочу хорошо выглядеть в бикини этим летом

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Так что мне нужно начинать сейчас

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: We have a session planned today
I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Я не совсем уверена насчет диплома еще

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: А ты сама предложила мне его оставить

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Но я буду продолжать до конца

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Не думала, что учёба с Итаном даст тебе столько мотивации

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Морковка в конце палки очень мотивирует 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ты даже не пытаешься это скрыть

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can come down whenever you want

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Доброе утро ❤️ Я потеряла серьгу и почему-то решила, что это твоя вина. Как у тебя утро?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это было подозрительно гладко для кого-то, кто только что проснулся.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я уже какое-то время не сплю.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не смогла уснуть?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я рано проснулась и не смогла снова устроиться поудобнее.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ничего драматичного, просто спор с подушками.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты могла бы написать мне.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты бы ответила, а потом обвинила меня в усталости.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это совершенно другое, чем обвинять тебя в ювелирных изделиях.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Конечно

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Подожди, нашла!

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это впечатляющее обвинение до завтрака.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Она застряла у меня в рукаве всё это время.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я бы хотела это извинение в письменном виде.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Дорогой красавчик, жаль, что доказательства не подтвердили моё вполне разумное обвинение

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Принято

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Отлично, теперь помоги мне решить, хорошо ли они смотрятся вместе

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 МИНУТЫ СПУСТЯ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Обе серьги, обе туфли, настоящие конспекты в сумке

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Очень убедительное впечатление о женщине, у которой всё под контролем

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Спасибо, это потребовало нескольких попыток

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я читала твои сообщения, пока их надевала.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: И да, они хорошо смотрятся вместе

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хорошо, потому что я больше не собираюсь переодеваться

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты никогда не собирался меня слушать, да?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не если ты был не прав 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Как ты себя чувствуешь по поводу сегодняшнего дня?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я написала {{name:aiden}} перед тем, как начала собираться

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Потом я засмеялась, уронила одну, и теперь у меня одна очень элегантная серьга.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Спросила, есть ли у него несколько минут после занятия

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Что он сказал?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Да, а потом он спросил, нужно ли ему принести конспекты, которые он взял

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хотя бы он помнит

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Он всё ещё не имеет понятия, о чём я хочу поговорить

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Из-за этого мне хочется объяснить всё по тексту, просто чтобы закончить с первым предложением

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это действительно упростит задачу?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Примерно на десять секунд

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Тогда я бы провела всё утро, гадая, смеётся ли он над своим телефоном.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты можешь начать с чего-то неловкого.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Дай мне посмотреть на ущерб.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я знаю, но надеялась сразу перейти к обаянию.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты справился со мной.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты был необычно снисходительным зрителем ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты покорил меня с первой обиды.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Тогда, может, мне стоит начать с того, что он раздражает.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
