story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты получишь все мое внимание

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Вот что я хотела услышать ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Должна ли я переживать, что ты заберешь все одеяло?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Только если ты планируешь спать очень далеко от меня

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я этого не планировала

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Нормально. Все еще иду медленно, но было приятно выйти на улицу

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Тогда все будет хорошо 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Хотя я не могу обещать, что не буду ставить свои холодные ноги к тебе

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Этого не было в приглашении

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Это идет с девушкой. Тебе следовало прочитать детали

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я выживу

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Хорошо. Я хочу, чтобы ты был рядом, когда я проснусь

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты меня там получишь

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Вот о чем я все время думаю

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Устраиваться с тобой и не проверять, когда мне нужно идти домой

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Мне понравилось, что ты был рядом со мной вчера

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я рада ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Завтра мы можем остаться такими

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ты заставляешь ожидание казаться длиннее 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Только до завтра днем

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я закончу паковать и постараюсь не смотреть на время

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Скажи мне, если хочешь, чтобы я что-то принесла на ужин

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Только ты и твоя сумка. Я позабочусь о еде

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Оба прибудут вместе в этот раз 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Спокойной ночи, дорогая. Я с нетерпением жду завтрашнего дня

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я тоже. Спокойной ночи ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Я хотела тебя кое-что спросить насчет завтра

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: О чем ты думаешь?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Утро ❤️ Моя резинка все еще в безопасности, или твой диван ее забрал?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хорошо, у меня нет времени объяснять еще один 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Сначала занятия, потом работа. Я просто собираюсь

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Если только твой охранник не приносит резинку для волос

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Спасибо, красавчик ❤️ Чем ты сегодня занимаешься?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Стирка, потом хочу закончить ту игру, которую начала

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Повесь стирку, прежде чем начнешь играть

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я бы предпочла услышать о твоей игре, чем о машине с мокрой одеждой 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я снова должен закончить в пять, а потом сразу домой

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты тоже. Я бы предпочла все еще быть на твоем диване, но автобус не будет меня ждать

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: И мою резинку для волос 😌 Люблю тебя

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
Yeah, better than the night before
I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я могла бы остаться под этим одеялом еще на час

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это было удобно, и мне понравилось общество ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
You're going to be punished for that.
Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Когда я вижу, насколько личным всё стало, внутри всё обрывается.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK зафиксировала, что субъект инициировал цифровое проникновение во время частной сессии после вопроса о необходимости продолжения ревизии.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Мне нужно знать, что она на самом деле чувствует: трактовки HAK недостаточно.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: После стимуляции профессор крепко хлопнул субъекта по заднице. Субъект не отстранился.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Просто проверяю, что ты все еще внимателен.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Я начинаю на самом деле любить эти частные уроки.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Почему я все еще должен пересматривать, если у нас уже есть... соглашение?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Просто заняло больше времени, чем ожидалось

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Потому что мне все еще нужно доказать, что ты работаешь со мной.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Так это только для бумажной работы?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Привет 😊 Я нашла скамейку для обеда вместо того, чтобы есть рядом с принтером сегодня

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Она висит, прежде чем ты попросишь доказательства

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Отлично, я горжусь тобой ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Мне нужно вернуться. Я напишу тебе, когда выйду

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Поговорим позже

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Позже тем днем, пока они проверяют расписание на следующий день в офисе менеджера...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Обсуждение в офисе зафиксировано рядом с {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Вчера нам было так легко вместе. А теперь я снова смотрю на этот кабинет и боюсь, что один хороший вечер ничего не изменил.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//ЖИВАЯ ТРАНСКРИПЦИЯ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ты хорошо выглядишь с распущенными волосами

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Это твой вклад в работу после обеда?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я могу восхищаться тобой и читать расписание

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Тогда попробуй сделать второе

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Большое улучшение

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Гораздо менее интересно

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Это займет еще больше времени, если ты продолжишь смотреть на меня вместо этого

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ты едва ли был тонким

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я не пыталась быть такой

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ясно

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Приходи завтра. Я приготовлю ужин

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: К тебе?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Там моя кухня

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ты знаешь, почему я спрашиваю

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: И ты знаешь, что я не приглашаю тебя, чтобы обсудить твою работу

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Это тоже создает гораздо лучший фоновый шум

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Мы говорили об этом вчера

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: У тебя были планы вчера. Я спрашиваю о завтра

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я имела в виду остальную часть нашего разговора

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: У меня был действительно хороший вечер с ним

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я уверена, что так и было

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Тогда перестань вести себя так, будто чего-то не хватает, и ты собираешься это исправить

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я не предлагаю ничего исправлять. Я хочу провести с тобой еще один вечер

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ты делаешь все таким простым

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ужин прост. Ты думаешь обо всем, что будет после

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я думаю, стоит ли мне вообще там быть

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Что у тебя?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Тебе понравилась другая ночь

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: А мне было ужасно после этого. Ты продолжаешь это опускать

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Мне понравилось, что ты был только мой на вечер. Я бы хотела повторить

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я не дам тебе ответ сейчас

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Тогда подумай об этом. Семь, если решишь прийти

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Позволь мне сначала закончить это

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} поворачивается к открытому расписанию на столе

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ее менеджер смотрит на ее задницу с другой стороны, откинувшись на стуле

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Визуальный захват заархивирован

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Он смотрит на неё, а не на работу перед собой. Ненавижу это чувство, будто только мне нужно, чтобы всё прекратилось.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//УВЕДОМЛЕНИЕ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Invitation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Приглашение

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Незадолго до пяти, с проверенным расписанием и подписанной последней страницей...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Это все. Я положу их с остальными

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ролл и яблоко. Ничего драматичного

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leave them there, I'll take them out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Оставь их там, я вынесу их

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ты могла бы сказать это до того, как я их отсортировала

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're sorted now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Теперь они отсортированы

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Тебе действительно нравится быть у руля

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at me a second
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Посмотри на меня на секунду

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Что?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want another kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я хочу еще один поцелуй

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ты знаешь, почему я колеблюсь

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я знаю. Я спрашиваю, хочешь ли ты тоже

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Хорошо... только поцелуй

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: После ее ответа менеджер встает и подходит ближе к {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Он наклоняется, чтобы поцеловать её и притягивает её немного ближе за талию; она отвечает на поцелуй

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Визуальный захват заархивирован

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ещё один поцелуй, и она отвечает на него. Наш вечер всё ещё многое для меня значит, но сейчас кажется мучительно далёким.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//УВЕДОМЛЕНИЕ

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another Kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ещё один поцелуй

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, that's enough
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ладно, хватит

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked that better than the paperwork
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Мне это понравилось больше, чем бумажная работа

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Вчера я говорила себе, что этого больше не произойдёт

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Мне больше понравилось решение на сегодня

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Конечно, тебе это понравилось. Ты не тот, кто идёт домой с чувством вины

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Мне понравилось целовать тебя. Я не собираюсь делать вид, что это не так

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я ухожу сейчас

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я напишу тебе про ужин позже

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Выглядит спокойно

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still haven't agreed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я всё ещё не согласилась

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я тебя слышала. Подумай об этом

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: После работы, по пути к автобусной остановке...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Я вышла ❤️ Иду домой

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Всё закончено?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Да, расписание на завтра наконец-то готово

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Что-то, о чём тебе не придётся беспокоиться сегодня вечером

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Да, на одну заботу меньше

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Напишу тебе, когда зайду внутрь

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ладно, поговорим позже

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Да. Мне нравится, что меня не спрашивают, где что-то, в течение десяти минут

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Твой супервайзер по стирке сегодня не на дежурстве?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Только если она действительно висит

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ты, похоже, очень рад этим частным урокам в последнее время

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Я даже жду встречи с ним теперь

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ты раньше жаловалась на каждую дополнительную сессию

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Или, может, я просто нашла лучший способ учиться

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Теперь прекрати меня допрашивать и иди спать

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ты в хорошем настроении и улыбаешься, когда приходишь домой

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Кто-то, похоже, ревнует к моему профессору

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Он просто действительно хорош в том, что делает

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Привет ❤️ Я дома. Ты смог закончить свою игру?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
You look comfortable
I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я ❤️ Хотя твоему дивану было бы лучше с другой компанией

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я сохранила то фото, которое ты сделал прошлой ночью

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
It was nice having you here
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Было приятно, что ты был здесь

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это действительно так. Я этого скучала

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: В следующий раз я найду что-то лучшее для просмотра

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне не так уж и противен этот фильм

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Твой смех в неподходящих местах был половиной развлечения

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Почти, я застрял на одном месте уже час

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
You're very good at it 😌
A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Немного позже её менеджер отправляет сообщение...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Вернёмся к вашему разговору, через несколько минут...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: О, я могу прийти домой немного позже завтра

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
Your manager too?
Yeah
A group thing this time?
Yeah, a few of us
Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Хорошо, просто дай знать, когда вернешься

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не нужно все вечер проверять телефон

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
Okay
And I did have a lovely time yesterday
You already told me 😊
I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я знаю, просто хотела сказать это снова

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я уберу тарелку и лягу спать

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
Sleep well
You too handsome. Love you ❤️
Love you too
Including blaming the controller?
That was the first thing
Very thorough 😌
What are you doing?
Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Уже переоделась. Готовлю что-то быстрое, потом не собираюсь много двигаться

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ладно, я иду вытаскивать тебя из кровати

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}} вытащил {{name:hailey}} из кровати после нескольких проигнорированных сообщений

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: А ты всё ещё в кровати

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
Don’t make me come up there

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Привет 😊 Сегодня без будильника, и я решила, что одеваться можно после завтрака ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я охраняла его все утро

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: ПЕРЕД ТЕМ, КАК ОНА УЙДЕТ ИЗ ДОМА

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ладно, у меня есть еда, фильм и крышка, которая действительно подходит на этот раз

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты собрала вещи для маленькой экспедиции

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Только потому, что тебе нельзя доверять, чтобы у тебя было достаточно салфеток

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Просто приходи. Всё остальное обсуждаемо

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это было так мило, что я перестала жаловаться

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я буду наслаждаться тишиной, пока она длится

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Недолго. Я уже в пути ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: В следующие двадцать минут — абсолютно 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: После этого я пойду на маленький рынок рядом с пекарней.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Для чего-то, что тебе нужно?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Мне нужно выйти из дома, не проходя тем же маршрутом хотя бы раз.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: И мне нужно что-то вкусненькое, чтобы поесть с тобой позже ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я думал, что паста — это что-то вкусное.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Она такая. Но паста не считается десертом, сколько бы ты ее не хвалил.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Вот и мой план на послеобеденное время.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты тоже получаешь фильм, который я выбрала.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я помню. Я не устраивала загадочное отключение электричества.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это подозрительно похоже на выходной.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Лучше не надо. Я наконец-то нашла такой, о котором ты мне еще не рассказал концовку.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это случилось однажды.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты сказал, что брат выглядел подозрительно, даже не успев заговорить.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Он был в перчатках в помещении.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Он мыл посуду 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Убедительный костюм

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Сегодня можешь оставить свои детективные расследования при себе

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Так и есть 😌 Никакой смены, никаких спешек сегодня утром.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я с нетерпением жду, когда увижу твоё лицо, а не буду гадать, что значит пауза между сообщениями.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Пауза была в основном из-за того, что я искал подходящие слова.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я знаю. Сегодня ты можешь говорить с полным ртом, как нормальный человек.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: С этим я справлюсь.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хорошо. Я хочу провести с тобой приятный день, а не очередную серьезную встречу.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты звучала так довольной прошлой ночью, что я чуть не пришёл просто, чтобы увидеть твою реакцию.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты можешь это проверить сегодня днем.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я открыла окно и пью кофе, пока он еще горячий ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я собираюсь. Очень близко.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Постараюсь не выглядеть слишком самодовольным.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это было бы прекрасным изменением 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты останешься дома после этого?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я еще не решила, как проведу весь вечер.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Вот что мне нравится в сегодняшнем дне.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Незнакомый опыт

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} прислал мне фото вывески аркады раньше.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Он нашел еще одно место, где жаловаться на проигрыши?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Похоже, он просто делал полезное предложение для моего выходного.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Вот как он тебя ловит.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я сказала ему, что у меня уже есть планы с тобой сегодня днем

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Он сказал спросить тебя, считается ли стол для хоккея на воздухе нейтральной территорией

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Только пока он не проиграет. Тогда стол становится частью заговора

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Может, я пойду позже. Мне будет интересно посмотреть, как он это объяснит

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не соглашайся на лучшее из трех, если ты уже выиграл

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Очень. Я могу стать трудной для совместной жизни, если привыкну к этому.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я это записываю 😌📝

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Парень с вчерашнего дня отправил мне сообщение о той книге, которую мы смотрели

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Та, что из магазина?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Да. Похоже, первая страница стоила того, чтобы вернуться домой

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я только прочитала аннотацию, так что сказала ему не зазнаваться пока

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Обнадеживающее начало книжного клуба

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: В основном мы ищем новые способы избежать того, чтобы сказать, что хотим продолжать разговор

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты заметил, да?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Может?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Может, я перестану быть тонкой позже

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Пока я сказала ему, что провожу день с тобой. Поговорим вечером 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Хорошо. Мне не хочется делиться своим отличным комментарием к фильму с телефоном

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я оставлю это в своей сумке. Для комментария, а не для тебя

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Да, мне стоит надеть нормальную одежду, прежде чем пекарня продаст все, что я хочу 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты даже не решил, что хочешь

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Вот почему мне нужны варианты

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я подожду расследования

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не ешь все свои закуски, пока я не приду

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Береги себя, я все еще решаю, что тебе принести.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: УТРОМ ПОЗЖЕ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Небольшое обновление: женщина из пекарни меня вспомнила

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это звучит приятно

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Она вспомнила, что я всегда говорю, что покупаю только хлеб

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Не очень хорошо для твоей защиты

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Она уже потянулась за большей сумкой

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Это точно не только хлеб

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Там есть хлеб. Где-то

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я купила два яблочных пирожка для нас и достаточно других вкусняшек, чтобы дорога домой была стоящей 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты выглядишь счастливым.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я да. Я потратила десять минут, глядя на цветы, не считая, где мне нужно быть дальше

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ничего не купила. Просто наслаждалась тем, что была там

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Нам нужно больше таких дней

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Да, нам нужно

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я иду домой за контейнером, потом приду после обеда, как мы и говорили

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Час тридцать все еще нормально?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Совершенно верно

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Я положу напитки в холодильник

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: И оставлю свою сторону дивана свободной

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ты выглядишь так, будто уже смирился с тем, что ничего не делаешь.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ты видел, какая у меня в этом попа? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: В спортзал или на свидание с тренером?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Только не ищи еще один неприличный наряд.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Привет ❤️ Я только что вышла на улицу, и уже придумала еще одну причину, почему твоя теория о фильме не имеет смысла 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Что дальше?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Фотобудка соблазнительна 😊.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Чтобы сохранить доказательства моего поражения?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Нет, потому что я хочу посмотреть, сможешь ли ты сделать четыре фото без гримас.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Вряд ли. Это очень несправедливый вызов

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ЧЕРЕЗ НЕКОТОРОЕ ВРЕМЯ, В ФОТОБУДКЕ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты понимаешь, что я испорчу хотя бы одно из этих фото

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Хотя бы одно? Это оптимистично

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Подойди ближе. Мне нужно каждое возможное преимущество

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так фотобудки не работают

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты принесла большую часть с собой

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Слишком поздно. Обратный отсчет начался

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Субъекты входят в фотобудку

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Серия личных фотографий сделана

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне хочется, чтобы ей было хорошо этим вечером, и я могу признать, что мне любопытно, насколько близки они становятся.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//УВЕДОМЛЕНИЕ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Фотострип I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Фотострип II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты сделал гримасу на первом

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: А ты улыбнулся на всех, так что я все равно думаю, что выиграл

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так не работает победа

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Тогда объясни последнее фото

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты поцеловал меня перед вспышкой 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: А теперь это сохранено навсегда. Пожалуйста

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я имела в виду тот момент, когда мы перестали говорить и просто сидели вместе

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты просто невозможен 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Все еще выбираешь пинбол после этого?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да. И я все еще не собираюсь весь вечер вести счет

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: На этом тоже есть счёт.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Свой можешь оставить при себе.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ПОЗЖЕ, НАРУЖИ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я забыла, как громко может звучать улица, когда тихо.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мои уши всё ещё внутри, играют в гоночную игру.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Твоя достоинство тоже где-то там.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне было весело.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я не осознавала, как сильно я скучала по тому, чтобы ты был рядом, пока не оказалась там

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Даже несмотря на то, что я выиграла?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Даже несмотря на то, что ты никогда этого не забудешь.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне тоже было весело.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Пойду с тобой немного?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да. Я думала сделать чай, когда вернусь.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Звучит разумно.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это было почти приглашение.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Почти?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Хочешь прийти на чашечку чая? У нас ещё остались пирожные, которые ты отказался есть перед своим выступлением.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне бы это понравилось.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне это тоже понравилось. Даже когда твой локоть нашел мои ребра

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И не спрашивай, где я держу второй контроллер.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Даже не собираюсь это упоминать.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я иду домой и забираю диван для себя на немного 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Уже скучаешь по комментариям к фильму?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я выживу. У меня есть книга и кто-то, кто, похоже, прочитал дальше меня.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Твой новый контакт?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да. Мы обменивались маленькими сообщениями с тех пор, как я ушла от тебя.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он помнил, что я встречаюсь с тобой, и ждал, пока я скажу, что свободна.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты слишком много занимал подушку

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Хорошо. Я собиралась возразить, что он прерывает важный спор о подушках.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Никто бы не понял это без нескольких фотографий.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Жаль, что нет документалки.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не подбивай меня.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ВОЗВРАЩЕНИЕ ДОМОЙ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Нашла свое место в книге. Это все еще закладка, которую положили в магазине 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это не очень большой прогресс.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я больше продвинулась в разговоре, чем в чтении.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я собираюсь ответить ему нормально, а не притворяться, что могу делать и то, и другое.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Поговорим позже.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да ❤️ Эта картинка была для тебя, кстати. Он не заслужил историю с embarrassing закладкой 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ПОЗЖЕ В ТОТ ЖЕ ВЕЧЕР

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ответ в картинках

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: У меня есть две фотографии, которые тебе могут понравиться. Он сказал, что можно показать тебе свою тоже

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Вы обменивались фотографиями?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да. Это та улыбка, которую он просил

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Будь хорошим. На этот раз я оставила тебе настоящие остатки еды

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: А это фото, которое он сделал на своей кухне. Пересылаю, не претендуя на качество съемки 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Фартук был нужен, чтобы показать его квалификацию?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Похоже, ужин не смог улыбнуться для камеры

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это ответ, который тебе понравится

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да, так и было. Я засмеялась, прежде чем смогла сделать вид, что не смеюсь

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Кстати, твоя фотография прекрасна

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я знала, что ты заметишь её первым ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И твою ложку

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Береги её. Я жду драматической встречи

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: У тебя было два часа, чтобы сказать мне

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я встречусь с {{name:aiden}}, как только оставлю контейнер дома 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Аркада?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да. Он сказал, что было бы жаль, если бы твои экспертные советы пропали зря

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он не знает и половины

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он уже предупредил меня, что одна из машин ест монеты

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Полезно. Оправдание готово до твоего прихода

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я разрешаю ему ровно одну

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я была занята попытками посмотреть это, пока ты всех в чем-то обвинял

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Щедро

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я хотела увидеть его снова, и что-то сделать звучало лучше, чем еще один осторожный разговор за кофе

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Иди развлекайся. Тебе не нужно еще одно мое наставление

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Хорошо. Мне хватит инструкций от детектива на диване 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: РАННИЙ ВЕЧЕР, У ВХОДА В АРКАДУ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Добралась 🎮 Это место слышно с тротуара

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не позволяй ему выбирать каждую игру

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он только что пришёл и указал на гоночный автомат

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Конечно, он это сделал

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я была права насчет одного человека

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я убираю телефон. Пожелай мне удачи 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он тебе не понадобится

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: В АРКАДЕ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты пришёл подготовленным

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Зачем?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Умные туфли. Это кто-то, кто ожидает победу

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это кто-то, кто сегодня утром гулял по рынку

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: На самом деле, я принесла тебе кое-что

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Уже утешительный приз?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Пирожное. Я всё равно могу его съесть

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: После того, как ты обвинил всех семерых

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Нет, я приму извинения заранее

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты делаешь это очень трудным, чтобы быть внимательным

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Спасибо. Это было мило с твоей стороны

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Вот. Видишь, сколько мало усилий это потребовало?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты собираешься контролировать каждое предложение сегодня вечером?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Только раздражающие

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это большая часть моего материала

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Тебе придётся импровизировать

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: ПОСЛЕ ИХ ПЕРВОЙ ИГРЫ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Первое очко не засчитали

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Тщательная детективная работа

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Машина не согласна

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты ударил, прежде чем я была готова

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты объяснял, как это будет легко

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я была дружелюбной

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ты сказал, что будешь со мной мягче

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И это явно была ошибка

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Так ты признаешь, что я выиграла?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Признаю, есть место для второго матча

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Нет. Ты выбрал первую машину. Я выбираю следующую

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Игра окончена

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} выигрывает первый раунд

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//УВЕДОМЛЕНИЕ

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: И все же ты не заметил, как я украла последний кусочек твоего пирожного

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Очень обидчивый проигравший

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Это {{name:player}} тебя подговорил

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Он предупредил меня, что ты попросишь еще один раунд, если проиграешь

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Я собираюсь с ним поговорить

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: О том, что слишком хорошо тебя знаю?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: О том, что тренирую противника

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Мне удалось ударить шайбу без вашей помощи

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Да, ты справился. Этот последний удар был хорош

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Извини, можешь повторить? Машина шумела.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Не дави на меня.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
